== Summary ==
Unscaled source-pixel comparison of the two official [[They're Tracking Us (V)]] paper layouts. Left: original image xref91 and transparency mask90 in [[:File:Errata-Sheet-2021-Summer-original.pdf]], page 1, with only 8 exterior top pixels removed. Right: original xref31 and mask30 in [[:File:Virtual-Set-7-September-2023.pdf]], page 3. The frame textures, type-bar positioning and footer/Set7-symbol placement differ; the wording and printed E1 are unchanged. Card pixels were not repainted, rescaled or sharpened; white canvas and labels added. Lucasfilm Ltd.; originals published by the Players Committee.
